title: Binance Bitcoin volume ratio hits record as futures outweigh spot eight times over
summary: Binance saw a record divergence between daily spot and futures trading volumes, with the latter reaching nearly $58 billion.

title: CleanSpark misses Wall Street revenue estimates as shares sink
summary: CleanSpark’s shares fell 5.5% on Thursday after the Bitcoin miner reported $138 million in quarterly revenue, narrowly missing Wall Street’s consensus estimate.

title: Stripe-owned Bridge joins EU MiCA register after Luxembourg approval
summary: Stripe-owned Bridge has entered the EU MiCA register following Luxembourg approval, joining regulated providers under the bloc’s crypto framework.

title: CLARITY Act delay gives Asian financial hubs an opening: First Digital CEO
summary: Industry figures warned that continued legislative limbo could slow institutional adoption, revive regulation by enforcement and push innovation offshore.

title: Coldcard exploit pushes July losses to $247M as second-worst month of 2026
summary: The Coldcard exploit, which caused more than $100 million in losses, helped push July crypto thefts to $247 million, making it the second-worst month of 2026.

title: Japan FSA asks crypto exchanges to impose withdrawal delays to fight scams
summary: Japanese authorities called for address registration, customer-specific limits and stronger authentication as part of a broader push to curb misuse of exchange accounts.

title: Proposed CLARITY ethics deal could save Trump millions in taxes: Bloomberg
summary: The latest bipartisan ethics proposal would reportedly require Trump to divest crypto businesses while allowing him to defer capital gains taxes on those sales.

title: Bitget explores licensed crypto presence in Bhutan
summary: Crypto exchange Bitget has signed an agreement with Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority to pursue a regulated local presence.

title: US Senate pushes CLARITY Act vote to September
summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune confirmed that the chamber was “punting” the vote until September.

title: MARA swings to Q2 loss as Bitcoin’s slump masks higher output
summary: Bitcoin miner MARA posted its highest quarterly Bitcoin production in over a year, but was overshadowed by a 28% decline in the average price of Bitcoin.
